svg.title: Payments grew faster than dollars transferred
svg.desc: July: 6,010,540 payments and $238,084. August: 17,855,635 payments and $437,476. Count grew 197.1 percent, dollars 83.7 percent. Mean transfer fell from 3.96 to 2.45 cents. Panels have different labeled units.
